models_evaluated: Antimicrobial prescription support API (decision-flow algorithm plus machine learning model)
unlisted_practices: Comparing AI antimicrobial recommendations with infectious disease specialists' prescriptions using WHO AWaRe classification as a stewardship benchmark

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI/ML API for antimicrobial prescription decision support using 10 hypothetical clinical vignettes evaluated by infectious disease specialists, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
